sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 660. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 660. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces healing received by 100% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only). [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Target: yourself. Applies Star Spirit's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases all stats by 50%, increases star elemental attack for all allies by 40, enchants the attacks of all allies with a 25% Dark Bane. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Dark and Star Defense from Unison Damage +700
